mapper.select: SELECT S.STUDENT_ID AS STUDENT_ID , S.STUDENT_NAME AS STUDENT_NAME , S.BIRTH_DATE AS BIRTH_DATE , E.EDU_NAME AS EDU_NAME , IFNULL(D.DORMITORY_ID, "X") AS DORMITORY_ID FROM STUDENTS S LEFT JOIN DORMITORIES D ON S.DORMITORY_ID = D.DORMITORY_ID LEFT JOIN EDU_INFO E ON S.EDU_ID = E.EDU_ID WHERE S.BIRTH_DATE = #{birthDate}

SELECT S.STUDENT_NAME AS STUDENT_NAME , E.EDU_NAME AS EDU_NAME , E.EDU_ROOM_NAME AS EDU_ROOM_NAME , E.START_DATE AS START_DATE , E.END_DATE AS END_DATE , IFNULL(D.DORMITORY_ID, 'X') AS DORMITORY_ID FROM STUDENTS S LEFT JOIN DORMITORIES D ON S.DORMITORY_ID = D.DORMITORY_ID LEFT JOIN EDU_INFO E ON S.EDU_ID = E.EDU_ID WHERE S.STUDENT_ID = #{studentId}
mapper.update: UPDATE STUDENTS SET ATTEND_YN = 'Y' WHERE STUDENT_ID = #{studentId} AND ATTEND_YN = 'N'
UPDATE DORMITORIES SET CURRENT_COUNT = CURRENT_COUNT + 1 WHERE DORMITORY_ID = ( SELECT DORMITORY_ID FROM STUDENTS WHERE DORM_YN = 'Y' AND STUDENT_ID = #{studentId} )
